items.title: A privacy first companion AI
items.raw_excerpt: I'm flabbergasted that people share their most sensitive messages with companion AI apps. Read their privacy policies. They can read your messages. They also have your email. That combination is a serious security threat. Replika was just fined €5M in Italy over exactly this. Yes, this is something I built. All inference runs on-device, no account, no chat data leaves your phone. Happy to defend every claim. www.friendai.pro https://apps.apple.com/au/app/friend-ai-private-chat/id67616...

items.title: Good AI Task – a tool for asking AI what it can and can't do

items.title: Track official AI company news and blogs in your Chrome side panel
items.raw_excerpt:
I've already picked up so much great news and tips from here — thanks to the HNers for sharing. That said, I still find myself manually checking various official newsrooms and engineering blogs.
To save myself from the constant 'tab hunting,' I built a small Chrome extension with a bit of help from Codex.
It’s been working well for my workflow, so I figured I’d put it on the Web Store in case anyone else finds it useful. Since many companies don't provide (or they just neglect) RSS feeds anymore, I built it to fetch the pages directly and extract the links.
I’ve limited it to one check per day to keep the traffic light. I’d love to get some feedback from you all so I can keep improving it. Thanks!
